test_title: PYST 29: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a straight horizontal line facing the north. Four persons are sitting between E and C. D is sitting between A and F. A is to the immediate right of E. Who is sitting to the immediate right of F?
solution:
Six friends A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a straight horizontal line facing the north.

1) Four persons are sitting between E and C.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42ad83e754da7ea2f25ac5a3e98f0e6f87767edd507d4a6011d4539f1988304b.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20673319cfa3e281c3f70bdec21d063cf94a2dbcfe663417f4a23281d4d35e33.png] 

2) A is to the immediate right of E.

3) D is sitting between A and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/606d6796075ab63ba6499485d313f1f539422f5421f8ecf029866a08524f71ea.png] 

Sitting positions of all six friends is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ec0e246ad3debc06202cbecc2eecef29cd7d5e4f8c617a5a02ecc68337357ff.png] 

∴ Here, 'B' is sitting immediate right of F.

Hence, the correct answer is **"B".**
